shloka_text: तदद्भुततमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वागस्त्यस्य राघवः । गौरवाद्विस्मयाच्चैव पुनः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे ।। 7.79.1 ।।
transliteration: tadadbhutatamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvāgastyasya rāghavaḥ | gauravādvismayāccaiva punaḥ praṣṭuṃ pracakrame || 7.79.1 ||
translation: तत् that, अद्भुततमम् most wonderful, वाक्यम् statement, श्रुत्वा having heard, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, राघवः Rama, गौरवात् out of respect, विस्मयात् out of wonder, च and, एव indeed, पुनः again, प्रष्टुम् to ask, प्रचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having heard that most wonderful statement from Agastya, Rama, out of both respect and wonder, began to ask again.
comments: Rama asks why that forest was desolate, and Agastya tells how Manu set his son Ikshvaku to found royal lines -- Ikshvaku's hundred sons included a dull and unruly youngest named Danda, who founded a city called Madhumanta between the Vindhya and Shaivala mountains, with Shukra as his priest, and ruled there.

shloka_text: भगवंस्तद्वनं घोरं तपस्तप्यति यत्र सः । श्वेतो वैदर्भको राजा कथं स्यादमृगद्विजम् ।। 7.79.2 ।।
transliteration: bhagavaṃstadvanaṃ ghoraṃ tapastapyati yatra saḥ | śveto vaidarbhako rājā kathaṃ syādamṛgadvijam || 7.79.2 ||
translation: भगवन् O venerable one, तत् that, वनम् forest, घोरम् dreadful, तपः penance, तप्यति performs, यत्र where, सः he, श्वेतः Shveta, वैदर्भकः of Vidarbha, राजा king, कथम् how, स्यात् could it be, अमृगद्विजम् without deer and birds.
explanation: O venerable one, how could that dreadful forest, where King Shveta of Vidarbha performed penance, be devoid of deer and birds?

shloka_text: तद्वनं स कथ राजा शून्यं मनुजवर्जितम् । तपश्चर्तुं प्रविष्टः स श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ।। 7.79.3 ।।
transliteration: tadvanaṃ sa katha rājā śūnyaṃ manujavarjitam | tapaścartuṃ praviṣṭaḥ sa śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 7.79.3 ||
translation: तत् that, वनम् forest, सः he, कथम् how, राजा king, शून्यम् empty, मनुजवर्जितम् devoid of humans, तपः penance, चर्तुम् to perform, प्रविष्टः entered, सः he, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तत्त्वतः truly.
explanation: I truly wish to hear how that king entered such a desolate forest, devoid of humans, to perform penance.

shloka_text: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम् । वाक्यं परमतेजस्वी वक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे ।। 7.79.4 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kautūhalasamanvitam | vākyaṃ paramatejasvī vaktumevopacakrame || 7.79.4 ||
translation: रामस्य of Rama, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौतूहलसमन्वितम् filled with curiosity, वाक्यम् words, परमतेजस्वी the highly effulgent one, वक्तुम् to speak, एव indeed, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having heard Rama's words, which were filled with curiosity, the highly effulgent Agastya indeed began to speak.

shloka_text: पुरा कृतयुगे राम मनुर्दण्डधरः प्रभुः । तस्य पुत्रो महानासीदिक्ष्वाकुः कुलनन्दनः ।। 7.79.5 ।।
transliteration: purā kṛtayuge rāma manurdaṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ | tasya putro mahānāsīdikṣvākuḥ kulanandanaḥ || 7.79.5 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राम O Rama, मनुः Manu, दण्डधरः wielder of the scepter, प्रभुः lord, तस्य his, पुत्रः son, महान् great, आसीत् was, इक्ष्वाकुः Ikshvaku, कुलनन्दनः delight of the family.
explanation: O Rama, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was a powerful lord named Manu, the wielder of the scepter, and his great son, Ikshvaku, was the delight of his family.

shloka_text: तं पुत्रं पूर्वंकं राज्ये निक्षिप्य भुवि दुर्जयम् । पृथिव्यां राजवंशानां भव कर्तेत्युवाच ह ।। 7.79.6 ।।
transliteration: taṃ putraṃ pūrvaṃkaṃ rājye nikṣipya bhuvi durjayam | pṛthivyāṃ rājavaṃśānāṃ bhava kartetyuvāca ha || 7.79.6 ||
translation: तम् that, पुत्रम् son, पूर्वंकम् the first-born, राज्ये in the kingdom, निक्षिप्य having placed, भुवि on the earth, दुर्जयम् unconquerable, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, राजवंशानाम् of royal dynasties, भव become, कर्ता the creator, इति thus, उवाच said, ह indeed,
explanation: Having placed that unconquerable first-born son in the kingdom on earth, Manu said to him, "Become the founder of royal dynasties on this earth."

shloka_text: तथैवेति प्रतिज्ञातं पितुः पुत्रेण राघव । ततः परमसन्तुष्टो मनुः पुत्रमुवाच ह ।। 7.79.7 ।।
transliteration: tathaiveti pratijñātaṃ pituḥ putreṇa rāghava | tataḥ paramasantuṣṭo manuḥ putramuvāca ha || 7.79.7 ||
translation: तथा so, एव indeed, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञातम् was promised, पितुः by the father, पुत्रेण by the son, राघव O Rama, ततः then, परमसन्तुष्टः extremely pleased, मनुः Manu, पुत्रम् to the son, उवाच said, ह indeed,
explanation: O Rama, the son assented to his father's command, and then Manu, extremely pleased, spoke to his son.

shloka_text: प्रीतो ऽस्मि परमोदार त्वं कर्ता ऽसि न संशयः । दण्डेन च प्रजा रक्ष मा च दण्डमकारणे ।। 7.79.8 ।।
transliteration: prīto 'smi paramodāra tvaṃ kartā 'si na saṃśayaḥ | daṇḍena ca prajā rakṣa mā ca daṇḍamakāraṇe || 7.79.8 ||
translation: प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, परमोदार O most generous one, त्वम् you, कर्ता the creator, असि are, न no, संशयः doubt, दण्डेन by punishment, च and, प्रजाः the subjects, रक्ष protect, मा do not, च and, दण्डम् punishment, अकारणे without cause,
explanation: Manu said, "O most generous one, I am pleased; you are indeed the creator, of this there is no doubt; protect the subjects with justice, but do not inflict punishment without cause."

shloka_text: अपराधिषु यो दण्डः पात्यते मानवेषु वै । स दण्डो विधिवन्मुक्तः स्वर्गं नयति पार्थिवम् ।। 7.79.9 ।।
transliteration: aparādhiṣu yo daṇḍaḥ pātyate mānaveṣu vai | sa daṇḍo vidhivanmuktaḥ svargaṃ nayati pārthivam || 7.79.9 ||
translation: अपराधिषु on offenders, यः which, दण्डः punishment, पात्यते is inflicted, मानवेषु among men, वै indeed, सः that, दण्डः punishment, विधिवत् according to law, मुक्तः administered, स्वर्गम् to heaven, नयति leads, पार्थिवम् the king,
explanation: The punishment that is properly inflicted upon offenders among men, when administered according to law, leads the king to heaven.

shloka_text: तस्माद्दण्डे महाबाहो यत्नवान्भव पुत्रक । धर्मो हि परमो लोके कुर्वतस्ते भविष्यति ।। 7.79.10 ।।
transliteration: tasmāddaṇḍe mahābāho yatnavānbhava putraka | dharmo hi paramo loke kurvataste bhaviṣyati || 7.79.10 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, दण्डे in punishment, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, यत्नवान् diligent, भव be, पुत्रक O son, धर्मः righteousness, हि indeed, परमः supreme, लोके in the world, कुर्वतः while performing, ते for you, भविष्यति will be,
explanation: Therefore, O mighty-armed son, be diligent in administering justice, for by doing so, supreme righteousness will be yours in this world.

shloka_text: इति तं बहु सन्दिश्य मनुः पुत्रं समाधिना । जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टो ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् ।। 7.79.11 ।।
transliteration: iti taṃ bahu sandiśya manuḥ putraṃ samādhinā | jagāma tridivaṃ hṛṣṭo brahmalokaṃ sanātanam || 7.79.11 ||
translation: इति thus, तं to him, बहु much, सन्दिश्य having instructed, मनुः Manu, पुत्रं his son, समाधिना with a composed mind, जगाम went, त्रिदिवं to heaven, हृष्टो delighted, ब्रह्मलोकं to the world of Brahma, सनातनम् eternal,
explanation: Having thus given many instructions to his son with a composed mind, Manu, delighted, went to the eternal world of Brahma, which is heaven.

shloka_text: प्रयाते त्रिदिवं तस्मिन्निक्ष्वाकुरमितप्रभः । जनयिष्ये कथं पुत्रानिति चिन्तापरो ऽभवत् ।। 7.79.12 ।।
transliteration: prayāte tridivaṃ tasminnikṣvākuramitaprabhaḥ | janayiṣye kathaṃ putrāniti cintāparo 'bhavat || 7.79.12 ||
translation: प्रयाते having departed, त्रिदिवं to heaven, तस्मिन् when he (Manu), इक्श्वाकुः Ikshvaku, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, जनयिष्ये shall I beget, कथं how, पुत्रान् sons, इति thus, चिन्तापरो absorbed in thought, अभवत् became,
explanation: When Manu had departed to heaven, Ikshvaku, who was of immeasurable splendor, became absorbed in the thought, "How shall I beget sons?"

shloka_text: कर्मभिर्बहुरूपैश्च तैस्तैर्मनुसुतस्सुतान् । जनयामास धर्मात्मा शतं देवसुतोपमान् ।। 7.79.13 ।।
transliteration: karmabhirbahurūpaiśca taistairmanusutassutān | janayāmāsa dharmātmā śataṃ devasutopamān || 7.79.13 ||
translation: कर्मभिः by deeds, बहुरूपैः of many kinds, च and, तैस्तैः by those various, मनुसुतः Manu's son, सुतान् sons, जनयामास begot, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, शतं a hundred, देवसुतोपमान् resembling sons of gods,
explanation: The righteous son of Manu, Ikshvaku, then begot a hundred sons, resembling the sons of gods, through various kinds of rituals and deeds.

shloka_text: तेषामवरजस्तात सर्वेषां रघुनन्दन । मूढश्चाकृतविद्यश्च न शुश्रूषति पूर्वजान् ।। 7.79.14 ।।
transliteration: teṣāmavarajastāta sarveṣāṃ raghunandana | mūḍhaścākṛtavidyaśca na śuśrūṣati pūrvajān || 7.79.14 ||
translation: तेषां among them, अवरजः the youngest, तात O dear one, सर्वेषां of all, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu dynasty, मूढः foolish, च and, अकृतविद्यः uneducated, च and, न not, शुश्रूषति serves, पूर्वजान् his elders,
explanation: O dear Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, the youngest among all those sons was foolish and uneducated, and he did not serve his elders.

shloka_text: नाम तस्य च दण्डेति पिता चक्रे ऽल्पमेधसः । अवश्यं दण्डपतनं शरीरे ऽस्य भविष्यति ।। 7.79.15 ।।
transliteration: nāma tasya ca daṇḍeti pitā cakre 'lpamedhasaḥ | avaśyaṃ daṇḍapatanaṃ śarīre 'sya bhaviṣyati || 7.79.15 ||
translation: नाम name, तस्य his, च and, दण्डः Danda, इति thus, पिता father, चक्रे gave, अल्पमेधसः to the dull-witted one, अवश्यं certainly, दण्डपतनं the falling of punishment, शरीरे on the body, अस्य his, भविष्यति will be,
explanation: His father named that dull-witted son Danda, thinking that punishment would certainly befall his body.

shloka_text: अपश्यमानस्तं देशं घोरं पुत्रस्य राघव । विन्ध्यशैवलयोर्मध्ये राज्यं प्रादादरिन्दम ।। 7.79.16 ।।
transliteration: apaśyamānastaṃ deśaṃ ghoraṃ putrasya rāghava | vindhyaśaivalayormadhye rājyaṃ prādādarindama || 7.79.16 ||
translation: अपश्यमानः not finding, तम् that, देशम् region, घोरम् dreadful, पुत्रस्य of the son (Lavana), राघव O Raghava, विन्ध्यशैवलयोः of Vindhya and Shaivala, मध्ये in the middle, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रादात् established, अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies.
explanation: O Raghava, O destroyer of enemies, not finding that dreadful region of Lavana suitable, he (Shatrughna) established a kingdom in the middle of the Vindhya and Shaivala mountains.

shloka_text: स दण्डस्तत्र राजाभूद्रम्ये पर्वतरोधसि । पुरं चाप्रतिमं राम न्यवेशयदनुत्तमम् ।। 7.79.17 ।।
transliteration: sa daṇḍastatra rājābhūdramye parvatarodhasi | puraṃ cāpratimaṃ rāma nyaveśayadanuttamam || 7.79.17 ||
translation: सः he, दण्डः the wielder of justice, तत्र there, राजा king, अभूत् became, रम्ये beautiful, पर्वतरोधसि on the mountain slope, पुरम् city, च and, अप्रतिमम् unequalled, राम O Rama, न्यवेशयत् established, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: O Rama, he (Shatrughna), the wielder of justice, became king there on the beautiful mountain slope and established an unequalled, unsurpassed city.

shloka_text: पुरस्य चाकरोन्नाम मधुमन्तमिति प्रभो । पुरोहितं तूशनसं वरयामास सुव्रतम् ।। 7.79.18 ।।
transliteration: purasya cākaronnāma madhumantamiti prabho | purohitaṃ tūśanasaṃ varayāmāsa suvratam || 7.79.18 ||
translation: पुरस्य of the city, च and, अकरोत् made, नाम name, मधुमन्तम् Madhumanta, इति thus, प्रभो O Lord, पुरोहितम् priest, तु indeed, उशनसम् Ushanas, वरयामास chose, सुव्रतम् righteous.
explanation: And, O Lord, he named the city Madhumanta and indeed chose the righteous Ushanas as his priest.

shloka_text: एवं स राजा तद्राज्यमकरोत्सपुरोहितः । प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णं देवराजं यथा वृषा ।। 7.79.19 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sa rājā tadrājyamakarotsapurohitaḥ | prahṛṣṭamanujākīrṇaṃ devarājaṃ yathā vṛṣā || 7.79.19 ||
translation: एवम् thus, सः he, राजा king, तत् that, राज्यम् kingdom, अकरोत् ruled, सपुरोहितः with his priest, प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णम् filled with joyful people, देवराजम् the king of gods, यथा as, वृषा Indra.
explanation: Thus, that king (Shatrughna), with his priest, ruled that kingdom, which was filled with joyful people, just as Indra rules the kingdom of the gods.

shloka_text: ततः स राजा मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रः सार्धं च तेनोशनसा तदानीम् । चकार राज्यं सुमहान्महात्मा शक्रो दिवीवोशनसा समेतः ।। 7.79.20 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā manujendraputraḥ sārdhaṃ ca tenośanasā tadānīm | cakāra rājyaṃ sumahānmahātmā śakro divīvośanasā sametaḥ || 7.79.20 ||
translation: ततः then, सः he, राजा king, मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रः son of the lord of men, सार्धम् together, च and, तेन with him, उशनसा Ushanas, तदानीम् at that time, चकार ruled, राज्यम् kingdom, सुमहान् very great, महात्मा great-souled, शक्रः Indra, दिवि in heaven, इव like, उशनसा with Ushanas, समेतः accompanied by.
explanation: Then, that great-souled king, the son of the lord of men (Shatrughna), together with Ushanas at that time, ruled the very great kingdom, just as Indra, accompanied by Ushanas, rules in heaven. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 79 ।। Thus ends the seventy-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
